verdict.rationale: Workable documents a broad REST API covering jobs, candidates, ratings, offers, members, departments, requisitions, stages, permission sets and webhooks, plus an official MCP server claiming "full programmatic access" across the hiring lifecycle. Several UI features have no documented API equivalent: posting to 200+ job boards, the careers page builder, the custom report builder, translation, and AI sourcing and recommendations. API scopes are also enabled through the Settings UI, and no explicit UI-parity statement or machine-readable spec is published. Missing for 10: documented API/UI parity, API endpoints for job-board distribution, careers page, reporting, translation and AI sourcing, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: We provide you with an API that gives you full control over your data.
